correctness.rationale: Every independent k-set of W_{3k+2}=C_{3k+2}² is a cyclic gap configuration with gaps at least 3; the k=2,3,4 vertex counts independently reconstructed are 12,22,35. Since open neighborhood simplices are precisely subsets of at least one H_k open neighborhood, independently exhaustive enumeration gave exactly 911,16,391,272,861 augmented faces and package face-vectors. An independent deterministic matching reconstructed all 447,8182,136419 face pairs; directed Hasse incidence graph acyclicity held over respectively 3700,89089,1913226 incidences. Fully reconstructed signed integral Morse boundaries have Smith unit diagonals ∂3:1^7 (k=2); ∂3:1^8,∂4:1^4,∂5:1 (k=3); and ∂2:1,∂3:1^10 (k=4). With no 1-cells for k2/k3 and a unit 1/2-cell cancellation for k4, primitive cellular attachments cancel successively. For k3 a possible π4(S3) component of the last five-cell is killed by triangular self-equivalence using its unit degree on S4, leaving S3; the other cases yield S2∨S2∨S3 and S3. Thus homotopy, not merely Betti, is established exactly for the three claimed parameters. The published total-cut types differ, so the corresponding nerve covers cannot be good.
